## 🔁 Reproduction and evidence
Steps, exact scene or screen, frequency, logs and screenshots. Include enough detail for another tester to repeat the result.

## ⚠️ Limitations observed
List crashes, missing assets, rendering issues, memory pressure, unsupported features or workarounds.

## Checklist
- [ ] Exact game build identified
- [ ] Runtime version identified
- [ ] Result is based on an actual test (not a guess)
- [ ] No game data or copyrighted assets attached
